messages:
anna.mountain: Urgent — had a fall while skiing in Zermatt, needed helicopter evacuation to hospital. Operator says they need a guarantee of payment / repatriation approval from insurer before transfer home. I
m stable but still in hospital.

leo.benefits: So sorry you
re hurt, glad you're stable. Rapid checklist: 1) we can contact insurer
nd medical assistance on your behalf, 2) we can issue a brief employer authorization letter with policy + claim intake + instruction to call insureror repatriation approval, 3) we cannot issue a payment guarantee ourselves but can request expedited review. Please DM me your member ID and the hospital/evac operator contact details.

claims_bot: Auto-note: For international emergency evacuation/air ambulance, contact travel-assistance@insurer.com (24/7) and call +44-20-555-0199. Required for claims: itemized invoice from evacuation operator, medical report, receipts, and repatriation approval paperwork. Typical urgent handling within 48 hours after medical assistance engagement.

anna.mountain: DM sent with hospital + operator phone and operator invoice photo (shows helicopter operator VAT and bank details). They want a letter that says "employer authorizes operator to bill insurer directly" — is that wording ok?

leo.benefits: We can include that phrase but must add the standard caveat: "This letter is for verification and authorization to contact insurer and is not an unconditional guarantee of payment." I'll call the insurer medical assistance line now and CC claims.

medclaims_team: Pinged insurer and opened emergency claim file. They
sked for the evacuation operator invoice, the hospital report, and an attending physician summary. Insureran often issue an authorization number for medevac if medical assistance approves; I requested expedited review and gave operator contact.

claims_bot: System update: medical assistance acknowledged receipt and assigned ref MA-2024-772. They will contact the provider directly. Please upload scanned receipts and any discharge/physician notes to https://benefits.redwood.com/claims -> "Emergency Medical / Evacuation".

sophia.hr: Anna, take care of yourself first. If you need a company contact for next-of-kin updates or help with travel arrangements, DM me and Ian coordinate flights/leave paperwork. Also save originals of all invoices and any translation if documents are not in English.

anna.mountain: Thank you everyone. Operator confirmed they got the insurer call and will wait for the authorization number before creating transfer plan. Leo, any estimate on how long insurer approval takes?

leo.benefits: It varies, but with medical assistance + urgent flag wexpect 24-72 hours. I
lso attached a one-page PDF letter to your DM that includes policy #, claims email, insurer medical assistance number, and the standard authorization phrase. Hand that to the operator and they should accept it for insurer outreach.

medclaims_team: Logged note: mark claim urgent for international evacuation. Once insurer sends authorization number, operator will invoice directly to claims@redwood.com. If operator invoices you personally, submit for reimbursement with invoices/medical report and the MA authorization ref.

anna.mountain: Got the PDF and operator accepted it on the call. Thanks team — will keep you posted when transfer goes through.
